units.en: By turning our trusted knowledge into an AI-ready asset, | we put the right information in the hands of every employee — | and every AI Agent — exactly when it's needed.
units.zh: 通过把可信知识转化为 AI 就绪的资产，| 我们把正确的信息交到每一位员工手中——| 也交给每一个 AI 智能体——在需要的时候恰好送达。

units.en: Together, we're building a smarter, more connected organization | where knowledge flows freely and intelligent decisions happen faster.
units.zh: 我们正携手打造一个更智能、联系更紧密的组织，| 让知识自由流动，让明智的决策更快发生。

units.en: Let's make Lenovo the model for a Knowledge + AI-Driven future.
units.zh: 让我们把联想打造成知识 + AI 驱动未来的典范。

source_text: By turning our trusted knowledge into an AI-ready asset, we put the right information in the hands of every employee — and every AI Agent — exactly when it's needed. Together, we're building a smarter, more connected organization where knowledge flows freely and intelligent decisions happen faster. Let's make Lenovo the model for a Knowledge + AI-Driven future.
